english.note: Use this specifically when the liquid being consumed is alcoholic or when saying that someone has been drinking alcohol.
Use 飲酒 when “use” means consuming alcohol, rather than for drug use.

examples.english: We are meeting to drink alcohol together tonight.
examples.traditional: 今晚我哋約咗一齊飲酒。
examples.jyutping: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 joek3 zo2 jat1 cai4 jam2 zau2

examples.english: I use alcohol to relax after work.
